invariants.rationale: partitionPath is a method parameter and should be non-null to identify the partition correctly.
fileId is a method parameter identifying the file and should be non-null.
recordItr is a method parameter and should be non-null to iterate over records.
recordItr must be an instance of Iterator<HoodieRecord<T>> for iteration.
partitionPath likely should be non-empty string to represent a valid partition.
